navigation_effect: restore only allowed controls; closed boundaries stay closed

failure_policy: block writes if reconciliation is ambiguous

navigation_effect: free or fixed exactly as disclosed
outcome_effect: presentation/progress follow T09; no automatic correctness

guard: local 5160-second deadline reached
failure_policy: idempotent expiry
disclosure_or_ui: state that this was a local global clock

outcome_effect: attempt history may record tries; final outcome remains typed

disclosure_or_ui: show original mode; route; versions; disclosures

failure_policy: keep blocked if recovery cannot reconcile
disclosure_or_ui: announce resumed clock and remaining time

outcome_effect: no response accepted from conflicting writer

disclosure_or_ui: accessible conflict message; avoid duplicate attempts

guard: target crosses closed item; module; or section boundary

guard: authoritative deadline or closed boundary precedes response

failure_policy: never overwrite sealed response
disclosure_or_ui: announce that the response arrived after closure

clock_effect: stop or let deadlines resolve exactly as declared; then seal
navigation_effect: disable writes; review depends on policy
outcome_effect: materialize not_presented; unanswered; technical states under T09
failure_policy: idempotent; never reuse attempt_id

failure_policy: preserve evidence; permit only a new attempt
